final: WITH station_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), totals AS (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_count FROM station_counts), shares AS (SELECT s.observstation, s.telescope_count, 1.0 * s.telescope_count / t.total_count AS share FROM station_counts AS s JOIN totals AS t ON t.total_count IS NOT NULL), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS mean_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.telescope_count) AS average_telescope_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - a.mean_share) AS average_excess FROM shares AS s JOIN average_share AS a ON a.mean_share IS NOT NULL WHERE s.share > a.mean_share
